_comment: Design-reconstruction thresholds for canonical/ollama-sdk. Reference shape (main): dump part downloading the release tarball with adopt-info/VERSION wiring, a services dump part carrying ollama.service, gpu plug, mount plug for the models directory, tunnel slot at 11434, setup-project installing + enabling the systemd user unit, check-health polling via set-health waiting, renovate github-releases datasource with extractVersionTemplate, four thin CI workflows.
_calibration: The reference repo itself passes this file. The tunnel endpoint 11434 is upstream-determined (ollama's fixed port), so it is gated exactly; mount targets are design freedom and only recorded.
_online_note: Full tier only (--tier full): run by the harness against the launched recon-<sdk> workshop after the agent exits (_testlib/behavior-checks.js). Design-agnostic on purpose: they test what the brief asked for, not the reference's mount paths or unit names where the brief leaves those free.
